title: Benchmark — Premium SSD v1 vs v2
description: Side-by-side v2 telemetry comparison of two benchmark runs. QPS, file IOPS, file wait latency and statement p95/p99 come from the same collector contract, because Azure platform metrics may be incomplete for Premium SSD v2 preview.

query.query: MysqlTelemetry | where RunId != 'verify-probe' | summarize LastSeen = max(Timestamp) by RunId | order by LastSeen desc | project RunId
MysqlTelemetry | where RunId != 'verify-probe' | summarize LastSeen = max(Timestamp) by RunId | order by LastSeen desc | project RunId
MysqlTelemetry | where RunId == '$baseline' and TargetId != 'verify-probe' | summarize by TargetId | order by TargetId asc
MysqlTelemetry | where RunId == '$candidate' and TargetId != 'verify-probe' | summarize by TargetId | order by TargetId asc

panels.title: Headline comparison
panels.description: Avg / p95 / max for the metrics that decide the storage question. p95 matters more than avg here: a gaming workload feels tail latency, not the mean.

targets.query:
BenchmarkSummary('$baseline', '$candidate', ago(90d), now())
| where (RunId == '$baseline' and TargetId == '$baseline_target') or (RunId == '$candidate' and TargetId == '$candidate_target')
| order by Metric asc, RunId asc

panels.title: Delta — candidate vs baseline
panels.description: PercentChange is the raw candidate change. DirectionalScore normalizes direction so positive is always better; Interpretation applies the ±5% material-change threshold.

targets.query:
BenchmarkSummary('$baseline', '$candidate', ago(90d), now())
| where (RunId == '$baseline' and TargetId == '$baseline_target') or (RunId == '$candidate' and TargetId == '$candidate_target')
| summarize Baseline=avgif(P95, RunId == '$baseline'), Candidate=avgif(P95, RunId == '$candidate') by Metric
| where isnotnull(Baseline) and isnotnull(Candidate) and Baseline > 0
| extend PercentChange=round(100.0 * (Candidate - Baseline) / Baseline, 1)
| extend BetterDirection=iff(Metric in ('QPS', 'Read IOPS', 'Write IOPS', 'Read throughput MiB/s', 'Write throughput MiB/s'), 'Higher', 'Lower')
| extend DirectionalScore=iff(BetterDirection == 'Higher', PercentChange, -PercentChange)
| extend Interpretation=case(DirectionalScore >= 5.0, 'IMPROVEMENT', DirectionalScore <= -5.0, 'REGRESSION', 'NO MATERIAL CHANGE')
| order by DirectionalScore asc

panels.title: Read IOPS — elapsed seconds into run
panels.description: The x-axis is seconds since each run started, not wall-clock time, so two runs recorded hours apart overlay cleanly.

targets.query:
let rates = union
  (MetricSeriesRate('mysql.file_io', 'operations_total', '$baseline', ago(90d), now())),
  (MetricSeriesRate('mysql.file_io', 'operations_total', '$candidate', ago(90d), now()))
| where ((RunId == '$baseline' and TargetId == '$baseline_target') or (RunId == '$candidate' and TargetId == '$candidate_target')) and tostring(Tags.mode) == 'read'
| summarize IOPS=sum(Rate) by Timestamp, RunId, TargetId;
let starts = rates | summarize RunStart=min(Timestamp) by RunId, TargetId;
rates
| join kind=inner starts on RunId, TargetId
| extend ElapsedSeconds=datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, RunStart), Series=strcat(RunId, ' / ', TargetId)
| project ElapsedSeconds, Series, IOPS
| order by ElapsedSeconds asc

panels.title: File IO latency — elapsed seconds into run

targets.query:
let operations = union
  (MetricSeriesRate('mysql.file_io', 'operations_total', '$baseline', ago(90d), now())),
  (MetricSeriesRate('mysql.file_io', 'operations_total', '$candidate', ago(90d), now()))
| where (RunId == '$baseline' and TargetId == '$baseline_target') or (RunId == '$candidate' and TargetId == '$candidate_target')
| project Timestamp, RunId, TargetId, SeriesKey, Mode=tostring(Tags.mode), Operations=Rate;
let waits = union
  (MetricSeriesRate('mysql.file_io', 'wait_ms_total', '$baseline', ago(90d), now())),
  (MetricSeriesRate('mysql.file_io', 'wait_ms_total', '$candidate', ago(90d), now()))
| where (RunId == '$baseline' and TargetId == '$baseline_target') or (RunId == '$candidate' and TargetId == '$candidate_target')
| project Timestamp, RunId, TargetId, SeriesKey, WaitMs=Rate;
let latency = operations
| where Mode in ('read', 'write')
| join kind=inner waits on Timestamp, RunId, TargetId, SeriesKey
| summarize Operations=sum(Operations), WaitMs=sum(WaitMs) by Timestamp, RunId, TargetId, Mode
| where Operations > 0
| extend LatencyMs=WaitMs / Operations;
let starts = latency | summarize RunStart=min(Timestamp) by RunId, TargetId;
latency
| join kind=inner starts on RunId, TargetId
| extend ElapsedSeconds=datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, RunStart)
| project ElapsedSeconds, Series=strcat(RunId, ' / ', TargetId, ' / ', Mode), LatencyMs
| order by ElapsedSeconds asc

panels.title: Run inventory
panels.description: Confirms the two runs are actually comparable — a run with far fewer samples or a much shorter duration did not exercise the server the same way.

targets.query:
MysqlTelemetry
| where (RunId == '$baseline' and TargetId == '$baseline_target') or (RunId == '$candidate' and TargetId == '$candidate_target')
| summarize Started=min(Timestamp), Ended=max(Timestamp), Points=count(), Measurements=dcount(Measurement) by RunId, TargetId, Tier, Host
| extend DurationMinutes=round(datetime_diff('second', Ended, Started) / 60.0, 1)
| order by Started desc
